metadata.method: Two fresh-worker rounds per fixture and phase, with reversed variant order in the second round. Parse, full HTML and direct-HTML eligibility attempts measured separately at the largest existing fixture per family. 500ms warmup, seven batches of at least 100ms with GC before each; separate 500ms CPU profile and 50-call heap sample at 4096 bytes, including collected objects. Position variants preserve the same reader tree after removing positions. Dedicated workflow runs are labeled in metadata; local runs remain shared-host observations. Samples are not performance thresholds.
